resources.name: Open-source DFT or tight-binding code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, DFTB+)

access.notes: Any comparable electronic structure code capable of geometry optimization and force calculations may be used.
Useful for structure manipulation and workflow control.

resources.name: Standard a-Si:H model generation protocol (melt-quench MD)

access.notes: Described in literature, e.g., Phys. Rev. B 57, 2253 (1998). The agent must implement a melt-quench procedure to obtain a 60-atom cell with ~10% H in monohydride groups.
